# Beam

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Beam")`

Draws a band of color or a texture between two attachments: a laser, a tractor beam, a rope of light, or lightning with a scrolling texture. It can be straight, or a curve that leaves each attachment along that attachment's X axis.

It is visual only: it collides with nothing, and it is drawn every frame where its attachments are drawn.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Attachment0` | `Attachment?` | — | read/write | The attachment where the beam starts. |
| `Attachment1` | `Attachment?` | — | read/write | The attachment where the beam ends. |
| `Color` | `ColorSequence` | `ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1))` | read/write | The color of the beam along its length, from `Attachment0` at 0 to `Attachment1` at 1. It is multiplied by the texture. |
| `CurveSize0` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How far the beam travels from `Attachment0` along that attachment's X axis before it bends toward the other end, in meters. With 0 at both ends the beam is straight. A negative value leaves in the opposite direction. |
| `CurveSize1` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How far before `Attachment1` the beam is already traveling along that attachment's X axis, in meters. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the beam is drawn. |
| `FaceCamera` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the band turns about its own length to face the camera. When it is off, the band lies in the plane of its attachments' Y axes, as a flat ribbon with two sides. |
| `LightEmission` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How much the beam adds its color to what is behind it instead of covering it, from 0 (an ordinary surface) to 1 (pure light). |
| `LightInfluence` | `number` | `1` | read/write | How much the scene's lighting affects the beam's color, from 0 (always its own color) to 1 (lit like a surface). |
| `Segments` | `number` | `10` | read/write | The number of straight pieces a curved beam is drawn with, from 1 to 64. A straight beam needs only 1. |
| `Texture` | `Content` | — | read/write | The image drawn along the beam, with U along its length and V across it. With no texture, the beam is a plain band of `Color`. |
| `TextureLength` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The length of one repeat of the texture, in meters, in the `Wrap` and `Static` texture modes. |
| `TextureMode` | `Enum.TextureMode` | `Enum.TextureMode.Stretch` | read/write | How the texture is laid along the beam. |
| `TextureSpeed` | `number` | `0` | read/write | How fast the texture scrolls from `Attachment0` toward `Attachment1`: in repeats per second in `Stretch` mode, and in meters per second in `Wrap` mode. In `Static` mode it does not scroll. |
| `Transparency` | `NumberSequence` | `NumberSequence.new(0)` | read/write | How transparent the beam is along its length, from 0 (opaque) to 1 (invisible). |
| `Width0` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The width of the beam at `Attachment0`, in meters. |
| `Width1` | `number` | `1` | read/write | The width of the beam at `Attachment1`, in meters. |
| `ZOffset` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The distance, in meters, the beam is drawn toward the camera. Use it so a beam that lies on a wall is not cut off by the wall. |
